owner.invariant: One exact carry-forward proposal version requires independent approval and an atomic execution claim before successor writes; the claim pins that version against revision, and exact successor completion is recorded only in recoverable private process state.
owner.boundary: ProgramRollover owns proposal, independent approval, and one atomic version-pinning execution claim/fence because the claim closes the revise-versus-execute race. Recoverable private ProgramRolloverExecutionProcess owns progress and verified successor receipts. A person authors the complete successor TypeIIPlan under its independent owner lifecycle. Prior proposal history and successor acknowledgements are not business aggregate state.
owner.identity: Tenant / program-rollovers / RolloverId, with exact source program/version and successor proof. RolloverId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId.

claimCommand.semanticRule: Internal process command; no public route. Atomically require status approved, exact ExpectedRevision, exact current ApprovedVersion/content SHA256 and latest actual ProgramRolloverApproved fact. Derive and copy immutable approval actor/role/time into ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimView; store CommandId and ClaimedAt; transition status to execution_claimed in one append. Exact retry only same command+tuple; reject all later revisions/rejections/claims. Event actor attribution retains the approving member; process identity is separately recorded in private process state.

event.selectedContract: State has status execution_claimed and one immutable ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimView copying CommandId, approved version/hash, approving member/role/time, and ClaimedAt. Removed CreatedPeriodId/CreatedTypeIIPlanId/NextPeriodCreatedAt from selected aggregate state; successor receipts are private process state.

stateContract.claimRule: Set exactly once in same atomic aggregate append that changes status approved -> execution_claimed. It copies the exact current approved version/hash and approval actor/role/time from the immutable approval history. It remains permanent across process success/failure. Every revision/rejection/second claim conflicts after this transition. The event/stream retains the proposal and approval facts.
stateContract.fieldRationale: Successor creation receipts and completion time belong to durable private process state. The business aggregate stores only proposal/approval and the concurrency fence.

stages.rule: A personal authorized actor authors complete TypeIIPlanContent under TypeIIPlan source validation. Freeze exact actual proposal version/content hash; do not invent missing baseline, system description, controls, findings or required changes.

Every pinned rollover record and commitment has exactly one explicit plan destination or justified nonrepresentation consistent with approved disposition; preserve exact source/version/hash; reject omissions, duplicates, mismatches and unsupported conversions; freeze complete mapping manifest/hash privately.

Wait for actual TypeIIPlanReviewed on the exact current frozen version/hash. Reviewer differs from proposer. Outcome approve advances to executive approval. changes_requested returns to human plan revision, owner source validation and a newly frozen exhaustive mapping for the new exact version/hash. Outcome reject terminates execution as failed; it never advances to period opening.

Wait for actual TypeIIPlanApproved on the same exact current version/hash whose review outcome is approve; approver differs from proposer and reviewer and satisfies owner rules. Approved plan is immutable.
Only after actual approved plan proof, issue exact next period/plan/examination/dates from pinned rollover. Verify TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted and original 202; accepted is pending.

Complete only on actual ObservationPeriodStarted chain linked to immutable opening intent, operation root/result, exact final plan proposal/revision/review/approval facts and hashes, exhaustive mapping manifest/hash, period/range, calendar authorization ID/generation and exact rollover claim. Store verified proof references privately; never emit ProgramNextPeriodCreated.

state.source: Current ProgramRolloverView stores CreatedPeriodId, CreatedTypeIIPlanId and NextPeriodCreatedAt, but selected target removes these and stores immutable execution claim; status execution_claimed blocks revision/rejection. Private process stores all actual successor proof references.

shape.instructions: Does the selected aggregate state shape encode an actual atomic immutable execution fence while avoiding successor receipt state?

criteria.adequate: One claim record copies command ID, approved version/hash and actual approver identity/role/time plus claim time; status execution_claimed; no successor receipt fields.
criteria.insufficient: A concurrency/fence binding or claim identity is missing.
criteria.wrong_boundary: Claim/progress belongs only in private process.
criteria.overloaded: Aggregate stores too much process progress.

transition.instructions: Can every transition and retry be distinguished and safely validated from this state contract?

criteria.true: Claim applies exactly once from approved at expected revision; exact idempotent retry is bound; revisions/rejections/second claims are invalid afterward.

approval.instructions: Does the claim pin the complete approval fact, rather than only approval status?

criteria.true: Approver identity, role, time, approved version, content hash and approval event are exact.
criteria.false: Approval proof can drift or be substituted.

process.instructions: Do successor IDs and final receipts belong in the aggregate state or process record?

criteria.process: Private process stores exact successor target IDs/receipts/result; aggregate stores proposal and permanent execution fence.
criteria.aggregate: Aggregate must store process progress and final receipt.
criteria.both: Both layers should duplicate the receipts.
